title: Identifying Potential Inlets of Man in the Artificial Intelligence Development Process
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or any specific religious groups. Its core focus is on identifying how the standard artificial intelligence development process contributes to the creation of antiblack technologies, framed through Sylvia Wynter's concept of the 'biocentric Man'.
